name: Wasp
tactic: Aim at exposed thrusters; destabilization can cause collision damage.

name: Hornet
tactic: Seek a rear angle rather than pouring rounds into front plates.

name: Firefly
weak_point: Yellow tank exposed when flamethrower deploys; armored thrusters
tactic: Fight outside flame range; use cover; do not infer a guaranteed one-shot.

name: Sentinel
weak_point: Small rear yellow capsule on swiveling arm
tactic: Peek from cover and break line of sight before converging laser fires.

name: Bombardier
weak_point: Yellow leg joints and rear cylinder
tactic: Use substantial cover; remove Spotters, which respawn; exploit post-artillery window.

name: Bastion
weak_point: Yellow joints and rear cylinder; exposed rear after cylinder breaks
tactic: Use cover and stagger windows; GearIII already complete so cells not current bench bottleneck.

name: Leaper
weak_point: Exposed inner sections after armor breaks; significant explosive resistance
tactic: Consider sequential Blaze burns and heavy-ammo finishing shots; maintain escape cover.

name: Rocketeer
weak_point: Focus two thrusters; unarmored upper thruster surfaces
tactic: Engage from substantial cover; no guarantee from generic body shots.
